release_notes: OLED 2.42 beta build 92. Keeps local-buzzer mute and buzzer-master OFF/ON confirmation messages visible on the OLED for five seconds after physical RIGHT-button or Web UI actions. Uses a non-blocking screen hold so Web access, Nightscout, alerts and background processing continue normally, prevents routine glucose/alarm refreshes and screen cycling from overwriting the confirmation, and defers backfill completion messages until the hold ends. Retains Build91 asynchronous OTA, high-priority Web UI service, live OTA progress, exclusive firmware-transfer TLS slot, 4096-byte streaming buffer and fast socket yield.
